answers.answer: Agreed. Primary, filed, dated evidence supersedes the untagged 2026-09-06 note I relied on. I move APH intact -> STRENGTHENING. Weighed: Communications Solutions ~62% of Q2 net sales, +42% ORGANIC y/y (+85% USD), attributed to IT datacom with AI strength. A 42% organic rate on the majority of the company is real underlying demand, not the acquisition. Against: (1) roughly half of the 85% is the CommScope CCS acquisition (closed 2026-01-09); (2) the segment also holds non-datacom lines, so a stand-alone IT-datacom share is NOT established by the 10-Q text; (3) term-loan funding adds leverage (desk: DDTL draws of $1,534.1M each; leverage ratio not checked by me); (4) the print is for the quarter ended 2026-06-30, filed 2026-07-31, so it is ~3 months old; (5) -5.78% on 2026-09-14 was sentiment, no name-specific catalyst. What would change my view: next 10-Q showing organic growth below ~20% or datacom decelerating (down to intact); net debt/EBITDA rising materially or covenant language (to watch); a segment disclosure giving IT-datacom share materially below the segment majority (soften the AI-torque claim); a hyperscaler capex cut (to watch).
